messages.content: What is the freezing point point of water at a pressure of 10 kPa?

message.content:
At a pressure of **10 kPa** (about 0.1 atm), pure water freezes at roughly **–2 °C**.  
This is slightly below the standard 0 °C freezing point at 1 atm, reflecting the small depression of the melting temperature as pressure falls.
